summary: Keep an offline token alive (it expires after 30 days of inactivity) by periodically refreshing it with a curl refresh_token grant to sso.redhat.com using client_id cloud-services; an expired token must be replaced.
questions: How do I keep my automation hub offline token from expiring?
How do I refresh the offline token with curl?
What happens if my offline token expires?

answer_card.title: Refresh the automation hub offline token
answer_card.answer_md:
Offline tokens expire after **30 days of inactivity**. Refresh periodically (e.g. from cron):
```bash
curl https://sso.redhat.com/auth/realms/redhat-external/protocol/openid-connect/token \
  -d grant_type=refresh_token -d client_id="cloud-services" \
  -d refresh_token="<offline_token>" --fail --silent --show-error --output /dev/null
```
If it has already expired, load a new one in *Connect to Hub*.
